name: maxrects-packer
role: Pack rectangles into atlas bins with MaxRects in Node; positions only
summary: npm module that packs rectangles (glyphs, sprites, frames) into one or more fixed-size bins with the MaxRects algorithm and returns each rectangle's x and y. It does not draw the atlas: composite pixels yourself. Strength: deterministic layouts from one pnpm dependency when inputs are sorted.
use_when: Laying out a sprite or glyph atlas for a pixijs, three-js or webgl scene
Fitting many frames or tiles into as few fixed-size textures as possible
Deterministic rectangle placement as data, then drawn with sharp or svg
avoid_when: Compositing the atlas image itself: sharp or imagemagick
notes: 2026-11-27: lead's version 3.0.0 and MIT confirmed on npm. The fixture did not use rotation or other options.

assessment.rationale: npm 3.0.0 published 2026-10-15; MIT. Niche but unique: no catalogue tool computes atlas layouts; msdfgen and the atlas consumers leave packing to others.

evidence.result: 24 seeded rects into 256x256 bins, padding 2: 2 bins (16+8), all placed, none overlap, min gap 2; layout sha256 5ea51174…fe identical across two Node 22.19.0 processes; preview inspected.
evidence.scope: 24 rects, smart option, no rotation, macOS arm64; positions only, no atlas image compositing; not other options or large inputs.
